description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/domain/ssl (base $0.005; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?domain=example.com (one hostname per call). To check a host's TLS certificate: one direct handshake on port 443 returns issuer, subject, SANs, valid from/to, days remaining, expired, hostname match, chain length and chain validation as observed, plus protocol. Input: one public hostname, one name per call. No HTTP request is sent. Errors are not charged. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged. On Polygon (native USDC), a request is settled only when it succeeds (HTTP status below 400). Failed requests are not charged.
